note: The reasoning arm of `eval_plan_scenario.json`, on the same nine steps, the same server build and the same weights, so the two logs differ by `think` and by nothing else that was asked for. Each model at the highest level it declares, because reasoning off is not how these models are used any more: `qwen3.8:27b-mlx` declares `low`, `medium` and `xhigh` (`/api/show`'s `thinking.values`, ollama 0.40.6) and `true` would mean `medium`, so it is asked for `xhigh` by name; `gemma4:31b-mlx` declares only `true`. One window, 262,144, which is both models' own: the first arm's 32,768 cells were served a 79,352-token prompt and answered from text 49,000 tokens back, so on this MLX runtime `num_ctx` bounds nothing and a second window would be a second draw of the first, not an axis. Its own log, because `one_arm_per_log` refuses two arms in one.
